tess: Quick micro-poll — two tiny things in one thread to save everyone
1) Which editor do you actually use most?
2) Which codename should we give the new small-text model? Reply with numbers/letters.

Options: Editors: 1) VSCode  2) NeoVim  3) JetBrains  4) Emacs
Codenames: A) Marlin  B) Cedar  C) Nimbus  D) Rascal

mike: 1) VSCode  2) C) Nimbus :thumbsup:
anika: 1) NeoVim  2) A) Marlin — vim gang :sunglasses:
sam: 1) JetBrains  2) B) Cedar
raj: Emacs forever. 1) 4)  2) D) Rascal (for the mischievous tiny model) :joy:
ops-bot: poll noted — current counts: Editors: VSCode 1, NeoVim 1, JetBrains 1, Emacs 1; Codenames: Marlin 1, Cedar 1, Nimbus 1, Rascal 1
maria: 1) VSCode +1, 2) B) Cedar +1
dena: 1) NeoVim +1, 2) A) Marlin +1
aaron: 1) VSCode, 2) B) Cedar
tess: thanks y'all — one more quick change vote if anyone wants to update their pick
sam: actually switching to VSCode on this one — 1) VSCode now, still 2) B) Cedar
ops-bot: interim tally — Editors: VSCode 4, NeoVim 2, JetBrains 1, Emacs 1; Codenames: Cedar 3, Marlin 2, Nimbus 1, Rascal 1
tess: Solid. Looks like VSCode + Cedar win. I'll update the README + model-metadata to use codename "cedar" and tag the repo. :tada:
mike: Cedar is adorable, good call :heart:
anika: excited to see cedar in the API docs :sparkles:
dena: can we add a tiny mascot later? :eyes:
dev-bot: /remind @tess to update model README tomorrow at 09:00 — reminder set
tess: awesome, thanks everyone! closing this thread. :v:
